transcript: I have 25 years and I am agree with you. I like very much the food in my city. Yesterday I went to the cinema with my friends.

sentences.text: I have 25 years and I am agree with you.
sentences.issue: Calco del español: la edad se dice con 'to be' y 'agree' es un verbo, no un adjetivo.
sentences.correction: I'm 25 years old and I agree with you.
alternatives: I'm 25, and I agree with you.
I'm 25 and I'm with you on that.

sentences.text: I like very much the food in my city.
sentences.issue: Orden poco natural: 'very much' no va entre el verbo y el objeto.
sentences.correction: I really like the food in my city.
alternatives: I love the food in my city.
The food in my city is great.

sentences.text: Yesterday I went to the cinema with my friends.

pronunciation.tip: La 'y' inicial es suave, como en 'yes', sin sonido de 'j'.

fluency: Buen ritmo en general, con una pausa larga antes de 'cinema'.
